newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Winterthur to raise A$127.4 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Winterthur to raise A$127.4 million.

text.p: Swiss-controlled HIH Winterthur International Ltd said on Wednesday it would raise A$127.4 million from the issue of 25.5 million unsecured convertible notes at A$5.00 each.

"A 1 for 12 pro rata rights issue of convertible notes by HIH Winterthur will raise approximately A$127.4 million and accommodate the dual objectives of providing for growth whilst increasing the group's permanent capital," it said.
"The monies raised by the offer will be employed to provide additional working capital and to retire A$40 million of debt owing to major shareholder, the Winterthur Swiss Insurance Co."
Winterthur Swiss, which has about 48 percent of the Australian firm, said it would subscribe to the issue which has broker J.B. Were and Son as underwriter.
